about: Stable error codes shared by the coordinator and the agent. Codes never change meaning once released; retire a code instead of reusing it. docs/error-codes.md is generated from this file by scripts/gen_error_codes.py.

codes.meaning: The request body has missing, unknown or invalid fields.
The request body is not valid JSON.
The request uses an OpenAI field or content type that IdleMesh does not support yet.
The request body exceeds the size limit (1 MiB).
The resource does not exist or is not visible to this caller.
The HTTP method is not supported on this path.
A generic HTTP error with no more specific code.
A client_request_id was reused with different content.
No valid session, credential or device token.
The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this.
A browser request is missing a valid CSRF token.
The group, login or passphrase is incorrect.
The account recovery details are incorrect.
Too many sign-in attempts; try again later.
Groups can only be created from the coordinator computer itself.
The invitation is invalid, expired or already used. (DIFA groups; replaced in sprint 9.)
That login is already used in this group. (DIFA groups; replaced in sprint 9.)
The group owner cannot be removed before ownership is transferred. (DIFA groups; replaced in sprint 9.)
The enrollment code is invalid, expired or already used.
The device certificate sent at enrollment could not be parsed.
The node is no longer authorized; the agent stops all local work.
Agent: enrollment did not complete (the coordinator refused or the reply was invalid).
Agent: the coordinator could not be reached, or its certificate did not match the pinned fingerprint.
Agent: the coordinator answered a heartbeat with an unexpected error status.
Agent: no heartbeat succeeded within the lease, so assigned work was released.
Agent: the state file is missing or corrupt; enroll the node again.
Agent: the state file could not be written or restricted to its owner.
A command-line option or configuration value is invalid.
Agent: a hardware or decode probe failed; the node reports without that measurement.
The device's owner has not consented to idle-data collection, so the coordinator refuses its telemetry.
Agent: buffered telemetry could not be delivered; it stays on disk and is retried.
Agent: the coordinator refused a telemetry batch as invalid; the batch was dropped and counted as lost.
Agent: the telemetry buffer reached its size limit and dropped its oldest records; the count is reported.
Agent: the on-disk telemetry buffer could not be read or written.
The device's owner has not consented to diagnostics, so crash reports, diagnostic bundles and remote log levels are refused.
Agent: the agent crashed; a crash report was saved and is uploaded on its next start.
Agent: a saved crash report could not be uploaded; it stays on disk and is retried.
Agent: a requested diagnostic bundle could not be built or uploaded.
Agent: the llama.cpp worker process could not be started.
Agent: the llama.cpp worker process exited on its own.
Agent: the worker used more memory than the owner's cap and was killed. It stays stopped until the cap is raised.
Agent: the worker exited on its own; a crash report with its exit status and last output was saved.
Agent: the operating-system memory limit for the worker could not be applied; the 250 ms watchdog still enforces the cap.
A worker or the inference server stopped responding during a request.
Agent: a connection to the worker tunnel failed mutual-TLS verification and was refused.
Agent: a tunnel connection did not finish its TLS handshake in time.
Agent: the tunnel accepted a connection but the local worker was not listening.
Coordinator: the tunnel to a node's worker could not be opened or verified.
A non-loopback llama.cpp worker would be used without the tunnel, so it was refused.
No llama.cpp endpoint is configured for a node in the placement.
The model is not in the catalog.
The model has no pinned model file for this backend.
The model file is not downloaded on the coordinator.
The model file failed SHA-256 verification.
The model's deployment is not loaded or not ready yet.
A node's owner has not accepted the model's licence, so it refused to download it (D-10).
No set of available nodes can hold the model under their caps and constraints.
The planned split cannot be expressed to llama.cpp.
The deployment cannot change while requests are queued or running.
The inference server exited while loading the model.
The inference server did not become ready in time.
Weights on one or more nodes do not match the placement plan.
This backend or model cannot prefetch partitions to nodes.
A node failed to download its share of the model.
The coordinator hit an internal error while coordinating prefetch.
This node has no partition to download.
A model-file download must request exactly one assigned byte range.
The requested byte range is not part of this node's partition.
The caller or the deployment has too many queued requests; retry later.
Not enough reserved memory is available to start the request right now.
The request waited in the queue too long and was not started.
Generation ran past its deadline and was stopped.
The coordinator restarted while the request was queued or running, so the request was ended.
The request did not finish within its overall deadline.
The request was cancelled by the caller.
The conversation is longer than the model's context limit.
The inference server returned an unexpected error status.
The request's visibility does not match the conversation's.
Shared conversations have one writer; fork to continue.
Messages selected for a fork do not belong to the source conversation.
The fork preview must be confirmed before messages are copied.
An unexpected internal error. The response carries a request_id that finds the full log entry.
